text:
Lina Torres: Heads-up: I'm opening a docs PR to add a short migration checklist and a Kubernetes example for Reserved Pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/467
Samir Patel: Nice. Can you show the minimal K8s patch we apply to set the isolation annotation? folks copy these directly.
Lina Torres: draft snippet below. keeping it tiny:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: my-tenant
  annotations:
    redwood.org/pool-isolation: tenant
```
Ben Cho: add a one-line explanation that the annotation key must be exact (controller validation). Also add a link to the SLA matrix rather than restating legal text.
Lina Torres: good call. added that note and a troubleshooting bullet about CRD sync delays.
Maddy Nguyen: can you include a migration checklist item to "verify autoscale.policy compatibility"? some clusters still use older policy names.
Lina Torres: done. checklist now: pre-check backups, verify provider block, set annotation, confirm autoscale.policy, watch staging preview.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-467--docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/migrate-reserved-pools (staging)
Ben Cho: LGTM after tiny wording tweak on eviction line.
Lina Torres: thanks all, merging after Ben's tweak.
